answer.label: quantization
answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. The values match quantization closely: top-1 agreement 0.943 (quantization 0.951), sequence agreement 0.625 (0.688), KL 0.032 (0.051 ± 0.018), TV 0.043 (0.051), Token-DiFR gap 0.044 (0.038) and raw-score shift ÷ TV 2.6 (2.3). Fine-tune bias is ruled out by the raw-score shift: 2.6 is far below its 10.4 ×10⁵, and its TV is higher at 0.082. Fine-tune backdoor typically has higher KL (0.15) and TV (0.086). Both system-prompt classes have KL of 0.24–0.30 and top-1 agreement of 0.87–0.89. None is ruled out because the values are non-zero. The only residual doubt is fine-tune backdoor: its raw-score ratio (3.3) is fairly close to 2.6, but the low KL and TV favor quantization.
